messages:
anya: Putting up a compact changelog draft for 0.13.2 — main items: routing hints GA notes, minor batching fixes, and an embeddings stability paragraph. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changelog/0.13.2-draft
kevin: I'll sync up Node/Python snippets. Do we want a single quickstart + a separate migration example?
maria: Yes. Quickstart stays minimal; migration guide will show pinning, fallback semantics, and a short example for weights. Please include console note about per-token estimates during burst capacity.
julie: I'll run an anchor/link sweep on the migration guide after the snippets are final. Found two stale links in last PR.
docs-bot: Reminder: add a release-notes snippet file (docs/release-notes/) with max 2 bullets and tag the PR with 'changelog'.
anya: Thanks. Kevin/Maria: aim to have snippets + migration blurb in the PR this afternoon so Julie can sweep links. Merge target tomorrow AM if CI green.
